senses.gloss: 2. भ (in gram.) N. of the weakest base of nouns (as opp. to पद and अङ्ग, q.v.) i.e. of the base before the vowel terminations except in strong cases, before feminine suffixes, and before Taddhitas beginning with vowels or य्, Pāṇ. i, 4, 18 &c.
4. भ m. (√ 1. भा) N. of the planet Venus or its regent, (= शुक्र), L.
भ n. a star, planet, asterism, lunar a˚ or mansion (and so also the number 27; cf. नक्षत्र), sign of the zodiac, GṛS.; Sūryas.; Var.; Śatr. &c.
5. भ m. (prob. onomat.) a bee, L.
भा॑ f. (आ॑) light or a beam of l˚, lustre, splendour, MBh.; Hariv.; Var. &c. (cf. 2. भा)
the shadow of a gnomon, Sūryas.
appearance, resemblance, likeness (ifc.; cf. अग्नि-भ, गुड-भा, तन्तु-भ)
भा [cf. √ भन्, भाष्, भास्; Gk. ϕημί, ϕάσκω; Lat. fāri &c.; Germ. Bann; Eng. ban.]
2. भा॑ f. (nom. prob. भा॑स्) light, brightness, splendour &c. (cf. f. of 4. भ), VS.; ŚBr.
भा॑ m. the sun, L. (cf. 2. भास्).
